mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the stretch receptors to the guided arm was most worthwhile because it added a useful explanation of how the arm can be guided without watching it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the visual route and then the motor nerves felt somewhat predictable, although the separate stages made the signal direction clear.

surprise.text: The support cells wrapped motor fibers in separate segments with gaps; I would be curious to learn how signals travel along them.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and goals gave each connection a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how the guided arm is used and how other body systems support it, though the combinations so far have been fairly predictable.
